dedupe_keys.name: select cpt based liquefaction case histories from the 2001 nisqually washington earthquake

description: Select CPT-Based Liquefaction Case Histories from the 2001 Nisqually, Washington, Earthquake is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Brett Maurer, University of Washington (washington.edu). While soil liquefaction is common in earthquakes, the case history data required to train and test state-of-practice prediction models remains comparatively scarce, owing to the breadth and expense of data that comprise a single case history. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-nsf8-7944. Keywords: Nisqually, earthquake, liquefaction, case history, cone penetration test. Published 2022-11-25. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
